rules.description: Disabled for EPA_GHGRP_ParentCompanies_Ownership because EpaOrganizationOwnership stores non-numeric facility DCIDs in value, which triggers Sanity_SVObs_Value_NotANumber when ImportExecutor runs dc-import genmcf without --allow-non-numeric-obs-values.
Verifies that EpaOrganizationOwnership reaches at least reporting year 2023 (static floor avoids Jan 1 rolling-year false positives due to EPA GHGRP annual reporting lag).

params.query: SELECT COALESCE(MIN(CAST(LEFT(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR), 4) AS INT)), 0) AS min_max_year FROM stats
